question: Hurka Baul is a dance form prevalent in the state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __Uttarakhand.____ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• Hurka Baul is a dance form prevalent in the state of **Uttarakhand**.
 
• The Hurkiya Baul dance is done in the fields while paddy and maize are being grown.
 
• After executing the preceding ceremony on a set day, the dance is done in several fields to various tunes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The dance is named after the Hurka, which is the drum that provides musical accompaniment to the dance, and Baul, which is the song.
 
• The only musical instrument used in the dance is the hurka.
 
• The singer relates the story of conflicts and heroic acts slowly and interestingly in the Hurka Baul dance performance. The actors usually arrive from two directions and execute the story in a sequence of snappy motions and appealing dancing styles.
 
• Other important dance forms of Uttarakhand are
 
 
• **Pandav** Nritya, 
 
• Bhotia Dance, 
 
• Cholia Dance, 
 
• Jhora Dance, and 
 
• Mukhota Dance.
